scientific_integrity: Analytical parity decomposition and explicit inverse formulas prove the infinite statements; a standard-library checker reproduces all finite truth-table classifications and characteristic polynomials. scientific_limitations: Two-sided binary odd-gap shift and centered radius-one binary local rules only; image/spatial entropy, not entropy of temporal iteration. The Rule-18/Rule-90 restriction is explicitly known prior work, and the complete census has residual unindexed-priority risk.
